facts_found: get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is the internal tool that retrieves a customer's bank accounts (checkings and savings) and requires only the customer's user_id. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 returns account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, and date_opened for each account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

Other internal procedures (e.g. interest discrepancy reporting) instruct agents to look up a customer's accounts with get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 before other actions, confirming it is the canonical account lookup. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044]

get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823(account_id) retrieves all debit cards for a specific checking account; it returns debit cards for checking accounts only (savings accounts have no debit cards) and may return multiple cards including closed history. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

The documented debit card fields returned by get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 are: card_id, account_id, user_id, card_number_last_4, status (ACTIVE/PENDING/FROZEN/CLOSED), issue_reason (new_account/first_card/lost/stolen/fraud/expired/damaged/upgrade/bank_reissue), expiration_date (MM/YY), date_issued, card_design (CLASSIC/PREMIUM/CUSTOM), daily_purchase_limit, daily_atm_limit. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

The PIN-lock state fields pin_locked, pin_attempts_remaining and pin_lock_reason are described as coming from 'the debit card lookup', i.e. the same card record retrieved by get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823, even though they are not enumerated in the general card-fields list. [doc_checking_accounts_green_account_(checking)_010]

get_bank_account_transactions_9173(account_id) retrieves the transaction history for a checking or savings account, returned reverse chronologically, with fields transaction_id, account_id, date (MM/DD/YYYY), description, amount, type, status (posted/pending). The PIN Lock Investigation Protocol directs agents to review the declined transaction history — transactions with type 'atm_withdrawal_declined' or 'pos_declined' — plus card data to compute fraud-risk flags (location, time, amount, card history, account history). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Flag D1 requires checking how many times the card's PIN has been locked in the last 90 days (0/1/2/3+ prior locks), but no tool or field name for retrieving PIN lock history is documented anywhere in the protocol. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

The protocol's unlock step is described only procedurally ('unlock after standard identity verification', 'after unlocking...'); no dedicated agent tool name or parameters for clearing a PIN lock are given. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892(card_id, reason) clears fraud alerts or velocity blocks; reason must be 'customer_verified' or 'velocity_clear', it cannot clear bank-initiated fraud alerts, and it is not described as clearing PIN locks. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]

The only documented PIN tools are reset_debit_card_pin_6284(card_id, last_4_digits, new_pin) for a forgotten PIN and change_debit_card_pin_6285(card_id, current_pin, new_pin) when the current PIN is known; both require a verified customer and an ACTIVE card (PIN cannot be changed on FROZEN, PENDING or CLOSED cards). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_027]

pin_lock_reason='security_hold' means the card cannot be unlocked by chat agents and must be transferred to the security team; if another card on the same account is also pin_locked, all cards must be investigated and scored individually before any unlock. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

If a card cannot be unlocked, options are card closure/replacement, transfer to the security team, or a PIN reset, and the transaction history must first be checked for successful unauthorized transactions. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]
